scenes.text: TikTok's new *AI shopper* buys for people *without leaving the feed*

scenes.title: What *changed*
lines: Oct 5: TikTok rolled out a Shopping Assistant, an AI agent that answers sizing, shipping and stock questions and finishes the purchase.
Plus one-click checkout straight from the For You feed. Built with Shopify, Salesforce and Stripe.

scenes.title: The *money* use
lines: Affiliates: fewer taps between your video and the sale means more commissions on the same views.
Sellers: list full specs in TikTok Shop, because the assistant reads them to answer buyers.

scenes.title: *Tested*, not hyped
lines: TikTok says 54 million Americans bought after watching a TikTok. Its own number.
Rollout timing and fees are not public yet. Source: Aisha Malik, TechCrunch, Oct 5, 2026.

scenes.title: The *cost*
lines: TikTok Shop affiliate is free to join once you clear TikTok's follower minimum. Each seller sets the commission.
Sellers pay TikTok a cut of every order; check the current rate in Seller Center before you price.
